_: The declared cost dependencies of every product, machine-readable.
This file answers one question the prose ledger could not: for a given
product, what does it cost to keep it alive? Two halves make that up —
`subscriptions`, which are fixed and per-product, and `pools`, which are
shared resources several products draw on and where the per-product number
has to be attributed rather than read off a bill.
`source` on every subscription says where the number came from. Nothing here
is a billing-API reading; they are hand-entered from the record named. Treat
each as last-known-state and re-verify before acting on it.
Edit this file, not the prose. `01-Knowledge Base/Infrastructure Ledger.md`
Part 2 is GENERATED from it by `ledger.py render` — hand-editing the prose
is how it went stale for three weeks while every fact around it moved.
`keys` names the LABEL in ledger/keys.md, never a value. keys.py is
the only thing that reads that file; nothing here or in the prose
